items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] They might have a picture of Charlie Woods.

ctx.x: I wonder if they have pictures or something. No. You know? I wonder if there's any pictures or photographers. Well, we should go there. Picture what? Picture of Lincoln Park, the Johnson Park, the balloons.
They might have a picture of Charlie Woods. I don't think they have a balloon here. They need to be things like that. How about you?
Do you have any pictures? No. They are too small. They're moving in the picture. I don't know.
